title: Fendi Baguette — Multicolour FF Terry
subtitle: The '90s icon in multicolour FF terry with tan leather
description: Fendi's most famous silhouette, reworked in textured multicolour FF terry jacquard framed by smooth tan leather piping. The signature FF buckle clasp sits on a leather tab; carry it tucked under the arm by the rolled top handle, or clip on the wide leather strap for shoulder or crossbody wear. Fits phone, card case, keys and lipstick.

title: Louis Vuitton Empreinte S-Lock Flap — Noir
subtitle: Monogram Empreinte leather with gold chain & top handle
description: Supple grained leather embossed with the Monogram Empreinte pattern, closed by the House's polished gold-tone S-lock. Carry it by the slim leather top handle, or sling the chunky gold chain over the shoulder for evening. A structured flap with a softly rounded body — the black-and-gold piece a wardrobe is built around.

title: Celine Triomphe Top Handle — Noir & Tan
subtitle: Coated canvas & tan leather with the gold Triomphe clasp
description: A structured top-handle flap in fine cross-grain coated canvas, edged in tan leather with contrast stitching. The sculpted gold Triomphe clasp — Celine's arc emblem — is the focal point; a rolled top handle and a detachable adjustable strap take it from desk to dinner. Compact, architectural, quietly Parisian.

title: Saint Laurent Cassandre Suede Crossbody — Cognac
subtitle: Chevron-quilted suede with antique-gold Cassandre
description: Velvety cognac suede, chevron-quilted in Saint Laurent's matelassé style and finished with the antique-gold Cassandre monogram. A slip pocket under the flap for quick-grab items and an adjustable matching suede strap with buckle. A warm autumn neutral that pairs as easily with denim as with camel tailoring.

title: Gucci Double G Top Handle Bag — Black
subtitle: Structured dome in smooth black leather, antique-gold GG
description: A sculpted dome silhouette in smooth black leather with piped edges, rolled twin handles and a two-way zip. The antique-gold Double G sits on a rounded leather tab — Gucci heritage, kept discreet. Spacious enough for a tablet, planner and daily essentials: the workday bag that goes straight to evening.

title: Louis Vuitton Monogram Canvas Hobo
subtitle: Slouchy zip-top hobo with natural leather trim & bunny charm
description: The House's iconic Monogram coated canvas in a relaxed crescent hobo, trimmed in natural leather that deepens to honey with wear. Top zip closure, a single shoulder strap on gold swivel hooks, and a playful enamel bunny charm on a gold chain. Roomy enough for a tablet, wallet and every daily essential.

title: Louis Vuitton Empreinte Chain Hobo — Noir
subtitle: Zip-top Monogram Empreinte hobo, gold chain & crossbody strap
description: A curved zip-top hobo in black Monogram Empreinte leather with double gold zip pulls. Wear it three ways — with the chunky decorative gold chain, the adjustable leather crossbody strap, or both. Finished with a collectible character charm: hands-free ease with evening polish.

title: Saint Laurent Cassandre Matelassé Pouch — Noir
subtitle: Chevron-quilted leather wristlet with silver Cassandre
description: A flat zip pouch in soft chevron-quilted matelassé leather, finished with the polished silver-tone Cassandre monogram. The detachable wrist strap keeps evenings hands-free; by day it slips into a tote as an organiser. Holds phone, cards, keys and a compact.

title: Fendi Peekaboo ISeeU Selleria
subtitle: Gold twist-lock top handle with whipstitched edges
description: Fendi's Peekaboo ISeeU: a structured two-compartment top-handle bag whose signature gold twist lock lets the front 'peek' open. The Selleria finish frames every edge in bold whipstitching, and the rolled top handle keeps the silhouette clean and architectural. Available in Black and Beige.

title: Fendi Peekaboo ISeeU Interlace
subtitle: Woven interlaced leather front with gold twist lock
description: The Peekaboo ISeeU with a sculptural interlaced front: strips of contrasting leather woven through the whipstitched frame for a crafted, three-dimensional texture. The signature gold twist lock, two roomy compartments and a rolled top handle. Colourways: Black & Blue, Beige & Olive and Sky Blue.

title: Fendi Peekaboo ISeeU FF — Black
subtitle: Tonal FF-patterned leather with FENDI logo strap
description: The black Peekaboo ISeeU worked in a tonal FF pattern, with the signature gold twist lock and a bold FENDI-lettered shoulder strap for hands-free wear. Two compartments and a rolled top handle — as sharp at the office as it is at dinner.

title: Coach Rowan Satchel — Signature Canvas
subtitle: Zip-top satchel in Signature canvas, eight colourways
description: Coach's everyday Rowan satchel in Signature coated canvas, trimmed in smooth leather with rolled top handles, a full-length zip and the horse-and-carriage logo plaque. Side D-rings take a detachable strap for crossbody wear. Eight colourways, from classic Khaki/Saddle and Brown/Black to seasonal Denim and Chalk.

title: Coach Mini Rowan Crossbody — Khaki/Chalk
subtitle: Mini zip-top barrel bag with adjustable leather strap
description: The Rowan in miniature: Signature coated canvas in Khaki with Chalk leather trim, gold-tone zip and hardware, and an adjustable saddle-tan leather strap for crossbody or shoulder wear. Holds phone, cards, keys and lip essentials.

title: Chanel Quilted Drawstring Bag
subtitle: Diamond-quilted grained leather, CC pocket & chain straps
description: Diamond-quilted grained leather in a soft drawstring silhouette, with a flap front pocket stamped with the gold CC and leather-woven gold chain straps. The drawstring top keeps everything secure while the slouchy body holds the day's essentials. In Beige and Caramel.

title: Gucci Jetset GG Marmont Shoulder Bag — Black
subtitle: Channel-quilted black leather with antique-gold Double G
description: From the Jetset GG Marmont line: a flap shoulder bag in soft black leather with padded vertical channel quilting, closed by the antique-gold Double G. The sliding chain strap wears long on the shoulder or doubled for a shorter drop. Fits phone, cards and lipstick.

title: Gucci GG Marmont Web Belt — Ivory
subtitle: Ivory leather & green-red Web stripe, antique-gold Double G
description: Ivory leather inset with Gucci's signature green-red-green Web stripe, fastened by the bold antique-gold GG Marmont buckle. A statement finish for summer whites and minimal outfits.

title: Dior CD Icon Buckle Belt — Black
subtitle: Grained black leather with brushed-silver CD buckle
description: Grained black leather with the sculptural brushed-silver CD Icon buckle and matching keeper — Dior's monogram in its most architectural form. A clean edge-painted finish that works with tailoring and denim alike.

title: Gucci Double G Belt — Black & Silver
subtitle: Contrast-stitched black leather, engraved silver GG buckle
description: Soft black leather with cream contrast topstitching and a polished silver Double G buckle engraved with the GG motif. Reads sharp with suiting and relaxed with jeans.

title: Louis Vuitton Damier Ébène Zip Wallet
subtitle: Compact L-zip wallet in Damier Ébène canvas
description: A compact L-zip wallet in Damier Ébène coated canvas — the House's ebony-and-brown checkerboard — with a silver-tone zip pull. Card slots, a note compartment and coin space in a slim profile that fits any pocket or clutch.

title: Louis Vuitton Zippy Wallet — Damier Graphite
subtitle: Zip-around long wallet in Damier Graphite canvas
description: The classic zip-around Zippy Wallet in Damier Graphite coated canvas — black and charcoal, understated and scratch-resistant. Multiple card slots, note compartments and a zipped coin pocket keep everything organised. A refined everyday piece and an easy gift.
